description: This file defines the EmailNotification class, an entity used within the OrangeHRM system to represent email notification settings related to HR events such as leave applications, approvals, and cancellations. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes properties for ID, name, enabled status, and related email subscribers.

classes.name: EmailNotification
classes.description: Entity class representing email notification configurations in OrangeHRM, with constants for different notification types and properties for ID, name, enabled status, and associated email subscribers.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the email notification.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the email notification.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the email notification.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the email notification.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the email notification is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Sets the enabled status of the email notification.

methods.name: getEmailSubscribers
methods.description: Returns the email subscribers associated with this notification.
